# RotateEntity <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RotateEntity:Void entity:Int32, pitch:Float32, yaw:Float32, roll:Float32, global:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |
| `pitch` | In | Float32 | required | Rotation around X in degrees. |
| `yaw` | In | Float32 | required | Rotation around Y in degrees. |
| `roll` | In | Float32 | required | Rotation around Z in degrees. |
| `global` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 to use angles of the world instead of angles relative to the parent. Defaults to 0. |

## Description

Turns an entity to an absolute orientation. The three angles are in degrees: pitch tips it forward or back around X, yaw turns it left or right around Y and roll tilts it sideways around Z. Without `global` the angles are relative to the parent. For a turn from the current orientation use [TurnEntity](TurnEntity).
